palm-coein.l: P - Polyp [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
A - Adenomyosis [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
L - Leiomyoma [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
M - Malignancy and atypical hyperplasia [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
C - Coagulopathy [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
O - Ovulatory dysfunction [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
E - Endometrial [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
I - Iatrogenic (includes anticoagulants from the 2018 revision) [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]
N - Not otherwise classified [0 = absent; 1 = present; ? = not yet assessed]

Leiomyoma secondary classification. REQUIRED when leiomyoma is 1; this tier carries the clinical weight [SM — submucosal, involving the endometrial cavity. From the 2018 revision this spans types 0 to 3.; O — other. From the 2018 revision this spans types 3 to 8, with type 3 straddling both groups.]

Leiomyoma tertiary type, optional [0 — intracavitary, attached to the endometrium by a narrow stalk (pedunculated); 1 — submucosal, less than 50 percent intramural; 2 — submucosal, 50 percent or more intramural; 3 — totally extracavitary but abuts the endometrium; 4 — intramural, entirely within the myometrium, no extension to the endometrial surface or serosa; 5 — subserosal, 50 percent or more intramural; 6 — subserosal, less than 50 percent intramural; 7 — subserosal, attached to the serosa by a stalk (pedunculated); 8 — does not relate to the myometrium at all: cervical, round or broad ligament without direct uterine attachment, or parasitic]

panc3.l: Hematocrit as a PERCENTAGE. Positive above 44. Reproductions print this unit as "mg/dL", which is wrong - hematocrit has no mass concentration.
Body mass index in kg/m squared. Positive above 30. Reproductions print this unit as "mg/kg squared", which is wrong.
Pleural effusion on the chest radiograph.

pc-ptsd5.l: Has the person ever experienced a traumatic event (for example a serious accident, an assault, a natural disaster, war, witnessing someone be injured or killed, or losing someone to homicide or suicide)? If no, the screen is complete with a score of 0 and the five items below are not asked.
In the past month, have you: Had nightmares about the event(s) or thought about the event(s) when you did not want to? (Asked only if a traumatic event was reported.)
In the past month, have you: Tried hard not to think about the event(s) or went out of your way to avoid situations that reminded you of the event(s)? (Asked only if a traumatic event was reported.)
In the past month, have you: Been constantly on guard, watchful, or easily startled? (Asked only if a traumatic event was reported.)
In the past month, have you: Felt numb or detached from people, activities, or your surroundings? (Asked only if a traumatic event was reported.)
In the past month, have you: Felt guilty or unable to stop blaming yourself or others for the event(s) or any problems the event(s) may have caused? (Asked only if a traumatic event was reported.)

pcdai.l: Abdominal pain [0 - none; 5 - mild, brief, does not interfere with activities; 10 - moderate to severe, daily, longer lasting, affects activities, nocturnal]

Stools per day [0 - formed stools, or up to 1 liquid stool, no blood; 5 - up to 2 semi-formed stools with small blood, or 2 to 5 liquid stools; 10 - gross bleeding, or 6 or more liquid stools, or nocturnal diarrhea]
General well-being [0 - no limitation of activities, well; 5 - occasional difficulty maintaining age-appropriate activities, below par; 10 - frequent limitation of activity, very poor]
Weight [0 - weight gain, or voluntary weight stable or loss; 5 - involuntary weight stable, or weight loss of 1 to 9 percent; 10 - weight loss of 10 percent or more]

Linear growth (score by height velocity when possible; the height-channel reading is the alternative) [0 - height velocity at or above minus 1 SD, or less than 1 channel decrease; 5 - height velocity below minus 1 SD and above minus 2 SD, or a decrease of 1 to less than 2 channels; 10 - height velocity at or below minus 2 SD, or a decrease of 2 or more channels]
Abdomen [0 - no tenderness, no mass; 5 - tenderness, or mass without tenderness; 10 - tenderness, involuntary guarding, definite mass]

Perirectal disease [0 - none, or asymptomatic skin tag; 5 - 1 or 2 indolent fistulae with scant drainage and no tenderness, or inflamed tags or fissures; 10 - active fistula with drainage, tenderness, or abscess]
Extra-intestinal manifestations (fever of 38.5 C or above for 3 days in the past week, definite arthritis, uveitis, erythema nodosum, pyoderma gangrenosum) [0 - none; 5 - one; 10 - two or more]

Age and sex band for the hematocrit threshold - there is no single low-hematocrit cut [child = 10 years or younger (either sex), 0 points at 33 or above, 2.5 points at 28 or above, 5 points below that; male11to14 = Male, 11 to 14 years, 0 points at 35 or above, 2.5 points at 30 or above, 5 points below that; male15to19 = Male, 15 to 19 years, 0 points at 37 or above, 2.5 points at 32 or above, 5 points below that; female11to19 = Female, 11 to 19 years, 0 points at 34 or above, 2.5 points at 29 or above, 5 points below that]
Hematocrit, scored against the age and sex band above
ESR - below 20 scores 0, 20 to 50 scores 2.5, above 50 scores 5
Serum albumin - 3.5 or above scores 0, 3.1 to 3.4 scores 5, 3.0 or below scores 10. Note this lab is full weight, unlike hematocrit and ESR

pecarn-cspine.l: Predisposing condition (e.g., Down syndrome, juvenile arthritis)

pecarn-head.l: GCS = 15 (uncheck if GCS 14 or other AMS)
Other signs of altered mental status
Occipital, parietal, or temporal scalp hematoma (age <2 only)
Not acting normally per parent (age <2 only)

pecarn-iai.l: Evidence of abdominal wall trauma or seat-belt sign

pedis.l: Perfusion GRADE (1-based, not the score) [1 = No signs of peripheral arterial disease, scores 0; 2 = Peripheral arterial disease, but no critical limb ischemia, scores 1; 3 = Critical limb ischemia, scores 2]. Contributes up to 2 points.

Extent GRADE (1-based, not the score) [1 = Skin intact, scores 0; 2 = Under 1 square centimetre, scores 1; 3 = 1 to 3 square centimetres, scores 2; 4 = Over 3 square centimetres, scores 3]. Contributes up to 3 points.
Depth GRADE (1-based, not the score) [1 = Skin intact, scores 0; 2 = Superficial, scores 1; 3 = Fascia, muscle or tendon, scores 2; 4 = Bone or joint, scores 3]. Contributes up to 3 points.

Infection GRADE (1-based, not the score) [1 = None, scores 0; 2 = Surface infection, scores 1; 3 = Abscess, fasciitis or septic arthritis, scores 2; 4 = Systemic inflammatory response syndrome, scores 3]. Contributes up to 3 points.
Sensation GRADE (1-based, not the score) [1 = No loss of protective sensation, scores 0; 2 = Loss of protective sensation, scores 1]. Contributes up to 1 point.

pen-fast.l: Reaction within the last five years

peradeniya-op.l: Pupil size. PINPOINT TAKES PRECEDENCE over "under 2 mm", which the published levels overlap [at-least-2mm = 2 mm or more, 0 points; under-2mm = Under 2 mm, but not pinpoint, 1 points; pinpoint = Pinpoint, 2 points]
Respiratory rate [under-20 = Under 20 per minute, 0 points; at-least-20 = 20 or more per minute, 1 points; at-least-20-cyanosis = 20 or more per minute with central cyanosis, 2 points]
Heart rate. Above 60 = 0; 41 to 60 = 1; below 40 = 2. EXACTLY 40 falls in NO published level and is REFUSED.
Whether fasciculation is GENERALIZED. Combined with the continuous attribute as a conjunction: either alone scores 1, both score 2.
Whether fasciculation is CONTINUOUS. Combined with the generalized attribute as a conjunction: either alone scores 1, both score 2.
Level of consciousness [conscious = Conscious and rational, 0 points; impaired = Impaired response to verbal command, 1 points; none = No response to verbal command, 2 points]
Seizures. HALF WEIGHT: 0 or 1 only, which is why the maximum is 11 and not 12 [absent = 0 points; present = 1 points]

pipp.l: Gestational age [0 - 36 weeks or more; 1 - 32 weeks to 35 weeks 6 days; 2 - 28 weeks to 31 weeks 6 days; 3 - less than 28 weeks]

Behavioral state before the procedure [0 - active and awake, eyes open, facial movements; 1 - quiet and awake, eyes open, no facial movements; 2 - active and asleep, eyes closed, facial movements; 3 - quiet and asleep, eyes closed, no facial movements]
Maximum heart-rate rise from baseline [0 - 0 to 4 beats per minute; 1 - 5 to 14 beats per minute; 2 - 15 to 24 beats per minute; 3 - 25 beats per minute or more]
Minimum oxygen-saturation fall from baseline [0 - 0 to 2.4 percent; 1 - 2.5 to 4.9 percent; 2 - 5.0 to 7.4 percent; 3 - 7.5 percent or more]
Brow bulge [0 - none, less than 10 percent of the time; 1 - minimum, 10 to 39 percent of the time; 2 - moderate, 40 to 69 percent of the time; 3 - maximum, 70 percent of the time or more]

plasmic-ttp.l: Hemolysis sign (retic > 2.5%, undetectable haptoglobin, or indirect bilirubin > 2.0)
Active cancer in the past year

pmr-eular-acr-2012.l: Hip pain or limited range of motion (+1)

poi-diagnosis.l: Small ovaries or low antral follicle count

pollock-flickinger.l: AVM volume. Multiplied by 0.1 in both versions.
Patient age. Multiplied by 0.02 in both versions.

Anatomical site. Chosen ONCE; each version's tier is derived, because the two published ladders classify the same site differently [frontal = original tier 0, modified tier 0; temporal = original tier 0, modified tier 0; parietal = original tier 1, modified tier 0; occipital = original tier 1, modified tier 0; corpus-callosum = original tier 1, modified tier 0; cerebellar = original tier 1, modified tier 0; intraventricular = original tier 1, modified tier NOT LISTED; basal-ganglia = original tier 2, modified tier 1; thalamus = original tier 2, modified tier 1; brainstem = original tier 2, modified tier 1]

polyp-surveillance.l: The examination was complete to the cecum
Largest adenoma, mm (10 mm or larger shortens the interval to 3 years on its own)
High-grade dysplasia (shortens the interval to 3 years on its own)
Piecemeal resection of an adenoma 20 mm or larger (a 6-month completeness check that outranks the table)

posas-observer-scar.l: Overall opinion (1-10, optional; not in total)

poseidon.l: Patient age. The classification splits at 35: under 35 gives groups 1 and 3, 35 or over gives groups 2 and 4.
Antral follicle count. Adequate reserve is 5 or more. ALTERNATIVE to anti-Mullerian hormone, not additional to it: supply either marker or both, but at least one.
Anti-Mullerian hormone. Adequate reserve is 1.2 or more. ALTERNATIVE to the antral follicle count, not additional to it: supply either marker or both, but at least one.

Whether a prior conventional-stimulation cycle has been done. Needed only when reserve is ADEQUATE, because groups 1 and 2 are defined by an unexpectedly poor response to one. Groups 3 and 4 are assignable with no prior cycle, so this may be omitted when reserve is poor.

Oocytes retrieved in that prior cycle. Required only when reserve is adequate and a prior cycle has been done. It decides both whether this is a POSEIDON group at all (10 or more is a normal response and falls outside the classification) and, below 10, the subdivision: fewer than 4 is a, and 4 to 9 is b.

ppm-eoai.l: Valve position. REQUIRED and never assumed - the thresholds are not interchangeable, and an EOAi of 1.0 is normal aortic but moderate mitral [aortic = Aortic, per Pibarot and Dumesnil, Heart 2006; mitral = Mitral, per Magne and colleagues, Circulation 2007]
Prosthesis effective orifice area. Use the MEASURED or REFERENCE effective orifice area, not the labelled valve size, which is a manufacturing dimension and overstates the opening.

priapism-gas.l: pO2 in blood drawn from the corpus cavernosum
pCO2 in blood drawn from the corpus cavernosum
pH in blood drawn from the corpus cavernosum
Perineal or straddle trauma before onset

propkd.l: Mutation category. REQUIRED, with NO "unknown" or "not tested" option: scoring PKD2 at 0 points asserts the mutation was FOUND, and an ungenotyped patient has no PROPKD score at all [pkd2 = PKD2 mutation found, 0 points; pkd1-nontruncating = Non-truncating PKD1 mutation, 2 points; pkd1-truncating = Truncating PKD1 mutation, 4 points]
Hypertension before 35 years of age. 2 points.
First urologic event before 35 years of age. 2 points. A urologic event means gross hematuria, cyst infection, or flank pain related to cysts. It is not any urological problem.
Optional current age. Does NOT enter the score. Used only to flag the documented limitation that the instrument may not identify rapid progression below age 35.

puqe24.l: In the last 24 hours, for how long have you felt nauseated or sick to your stomach? NOTE THE MINIMUM IS 1, NOT 0 [1 = Not at all; 2 = 1 hour or less; 3 = 2 to 3 hours; 4 = 4 to 6 hours; 5 = More than 6 hours]
In the last 24 hours, how many times have you vomited or thrown up? NOTE THE MINIMUM IS 1, NOT 0 [1 = Not at all; 2 = 1 to 2 times; 3 = 3 to 4 times; 4 = 5 to 6 times; 5 = 7 or more times]

In the last 24 hours, how many times have you had retching or dry heaves without bringing anything up? NOTE THE MINIMUM IS 1, NOT 0 [1 = Not at all; 2 = 1 to 2 times; 3 = 3 to 4 times; 4 = 5 to 6 times; 5 = 7 or more times]

Optional, NEVER SUMMED. The patient rating of her own well-being from 0, the worst possible, to 10, as good as she felt before pregnancy. It is NOT part of the total and runs in the OPPOSITE direction to the score: higher is better here, while a higher PUQE score is worse.

pure-tone-average.l: Air-conduction threshold at 4000 Hz (optional, for the 4-frequency average)

push-tool.l: Wound width (cm); area = length x width, scored 0-10 by category
Exudate amount: 0 none, 1 light, 2 moderate, 3 heavy
Tissue type (worst present): 0 closed, 1 epithelial, 2 granulation, 3 slough, 4 necrotic
